about: Rules for scripts/engagement_dependency_map.py: which objects count as live, how used_by prefixes map to object kinds, and how references are matched inside saved definitions. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.live_kinds: Object kinds that reach customers. A dependant of one of these kinds with a live status blocks deletion.
notes.live_statuses: Statuses (compared case-insensitively) that count as live for a live kind. Draft, inactive, paused, finished and archived objects aren't live. A live kind with no status is reported as 'status unknown' and treated as a reason to check, not as safe.
notes.reporting_kinds: Object kinds that only measure. Deleting something they use breaks a report or dashboard, which is a medium finding, not a block.
notes.used_by_prefixes: How each used_by entry (<prefix>_<id>) maps to an object kind. The id is everything after the last underscore. Prefixes not listed here are kept as their own kind and treated as not live.
notes.kinds: The object kinds the script accepts in --list, --detail and --target. A kind seen only through used_by (email_block, metric and so on) is added automatically.
notes.name_only_kinds: Kinds whose ID is just their name. They're matched only through name_keys and jinja_patterns, never as a bare word, so a property that happens to share the name isn't counted.
notes.name_keys: Kinds referenced by name rather than ID, and the JSON keys whose whole value is that name. A consent category appears as {"category": "newsletter"} in filters and as consent_category on campaign steps.
notes.jinja_patterns: Regular expressions (case-insensitive) for references in Jinja and template code. {name} is replaced by the escaped reference name, and for aggregates, expressions and segmentations also by the escaped ID. A match counts as a reference by name.
notes.min_id_chars: IDs shorter than this aren't searched for inside longer strings (only as whole values), to avoid accidental matches.
notes.min_name_match_chars: A target's name is matched as a whole string value only if it has at least this many characters. Name matches are labelled 'name (verify)' because two objects can share a name.
notes.max_path_hops: Indirect dependants further than this many hops away are still counted, but their path isn't printed.
notes.max_dependants_listed: At most this many dependants are listed per target in the output; the rest are counted.
